parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State one difference between a hadron and a lepton.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.part_stem:
A stationary nucleus of copper-64 ($^{64}_{29}\text{Cu}$) undergoes $\beta^+$ decay to form a nucleus of nickel (Ni), a positron and a neutrino:
$$^{64}_{29}\text{Cu} \to ^{A}_{Z}\text{Ni} + \beta^+ + \nu_e$$

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: State the name of the interaction or force that gives rise to this decay.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: State three quantities that are conserved in the decay.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Use the quark composition of a proton to show that it has a charge of $+e$, where $e$ is the elementary charge. Explain your working.
